data.one_liner: Text with metadata spans for easy text editing and styling.
data.what_it_does: Combines a standard string with arbitrary metadata spans, allowing developers to attach formatting like bold, italics, or custom links to specific character ranges. It forms the basis of all text representation within super_editor.
use_when: You are building a rich text editor or custom text rendering engine.
You need to manage overlapping or styled text spans programmatically.
avoid_when: You only need basic styled text using Flutter's built-in Text and TextSpan widgets.
strengths: Forms a robust foundation for rich text editing and super_editor.
Supports both named attributions and custom metadata classes.
weaknesses: Low-level text representation utility rather than an out-of-the-box rich text UI widget.
